messages:
Priya: Quick thread to agree on pin tiers and canary SLAs. Two customer tiers proposed: standard (7d heads-up, no pin) and premium soft-pin (30/60/90d). Who owns economics + contract language?

Jae: I can draft pricing tiers. Need clarity on credit triggers (bench failure vs customer-reported).

Ravi: Ops: canary SLA idea: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% staged over 24h with 48h hold. Automatic rollback on p95 delta > 25ms or quality fail on eval set.

Tess: I'll own the rollout doc and fast-kill runbook. Also recommending per-tenant threshold overrides for big customers.

LegalBot: Flag: quantify "customer-reported" regressions and acceptability criteria in clause. I'll add boilerplate.

Priya: Great. Action: Jae pricing draft by Tue, Tess rollout doc by Fri, Legal to draft clause. We plan RFC next week. :thumbsup:
